note: Hillside RV park on Milan Hill, mostly seasonal sites with five transient pull-throughs. No power at the sites: generators run 7 am to 10 pm, and a mobile tank fills fresh water. Above-ground pool, snack shack, portable toilets around the park, and direct access to ATV trails. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Google + imagery: $40 (septic only, no power, no water hookup), 5 transient pull-throughs (45 ft) among mostly seasonal sites, open May 20 to Oct 18 (2026), Firefly booking, Google 5.0 (56). DROP CANDIDATE: mostly seasonal (5 transit sites), no power. OHV side flagged.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay: mostly seasonal). Campground page: 'Our campground features a mix of seasonal and transit RV/Trailer sites'; home page: 'We have 5 transit sites available Plus we have a renal camper available'. Esri imagery shows ~45-50 rigs packed on the loops, so the 5 transient sites are roughly 10% of the park. Against 'iffy': Google 5.0 stars on 56 reviews, and it sells nightly online through Firefly. The facilities are basic (no electric, generators 7 am-10 pm, water from a mobile tank, portable toilets plus one bathhouse). AWH call.

Private park: Google Maps 5.0 stars, 56 reviews. Price $40 a night (one rate all season, so cheapest and summer peak are both $40), under the $50 gate. No Good Sam/RV Life price change examined beyond the operator's page.
OHV (flag only): 'We have direct access to trails for hiking and ATV riding'; the park sells OHRV registrations. An RV park with an ATV side, not a staging area.
